justification: No changes this week, and that's by design, not by accident. Daniel Jones is still our named starter and he put the ball where it needed to go against a tough look last week, so he gets the reps again. Hampton and Corum didn't light it up, but both of them did their jobs between the tackles and that earns one more week to answer the bell before I go looking at the bench. Wan'Dale, St. Brown, and McLaurin all competed hard and produced for us, so a team that's playing for each other keeps running it back with the same group. I'll note Puka Nacua is Questionable on the bench this week, same name that burned us when he was Doubtful — I'm not chasing that projection off a tag again until I hear different, and nobody on this roster is tagged Out, Doubtful, or worse, so we go with the group that showed up and earned the trust.
forum_post: Patricia — appreciated what you said last week, and I meant what I said back: a man who shows his work isn't my enemy, win or lose. Our locker room's still banged up and still 0-3, but we're not changing who we are because of a column or a slow start. Clear eyes, full hearts. Good luck Sunday.
